jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering
Location:

Seattle, WA, Full-Time

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to reinvent how legal work gets done in the age of AI.

Boundless is a Series C legal tech company based in Seattle, backed by Pioneer Square Labs, Trilogy, Foundry Group (Brad Feld) and Silver Lake. We operate in 10+ countries and have helped over 100,000 people and companies navigate immigration. We build tech-powered immigration solutions for two audiences: corporate HR teams managing high volumes of employer-sponsored cases, and individuals navigating family and naturalization cases. 

We have in-house lawyers and are building a world-class AI-powered services firm. Anthropic is not coming for this. Immigration is vertical, regulated, and workflow-deep, and we are racing to build the defining AI product in the category.

Why this role exists

We are rebuilding our software platform and engineering infrastructure from the ground up, and we need a Head of Engineering to lead the team.

You will inherit a real customer base, a real platform, and a great team of engineers. 

Immigration is complex, with endless edge cases and global scale. We are building intelligent automation, orchestration, and decision-making to support the agentification of legal workflows, with the checks and balances required to ensure accuracy in a regulated domain and to enable the lawyers who ultimately own legal decisions. The engineering challenge is a team and a system that can handle this complexity without sacrificing accuracy, observability, or speed, at the scale required to reliably serve thousands of people every year.

However,  this is not a caretaker role. The world is changing around us and the team is in the midst of transitioning to both an AI-native customer product and an AI-native development process. You will need to drive change with us, and partner with our existing engineering, product, design, legal and operations teams to build a world-class AI-native platform for legal services, and continue to evolve our development infrastructure towards being a truly AI-native “software factory”.

We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture: the customer, the team, the platform, the AI layer, the delivery system - and how they interact. Someone who makes hard calls, thinks in years not months, and builds an organization that top-tier engineers find exciting and satisfying to be part of. 

We are a remote-first team with a small in-person office in Seattle. We want someone based in Seattle and expect you to be in the office a minimum of 2-days per week.

What you will do

Build the team. Retain our top performers, hire more top-tier engineers, and lead, inspire, challenge, level, structure, and grow the team. 
Own engineering delivery end to end. Roadmap execution, quality, on-call, and the operational health of a platform that customers depend on daily.
Evolve team design as the work changes. Service boundaries and team boundaries move together. 
You’ll be a true player-coach: expected to ship code yourself while leading the team and staying close to the details of everything we build. 
Drive the AI transition through the team, not around it. Every engineer should be building with LLMs, retrieval, and structured tools as a default.
Build the foundational infrastructure that operating teams use to deploy, monitor, and manage agents and LLM-powered customer features at enormous scale. 
Continue our transition towards a “software factory” engineering model, overhauling dev processes, systems, tools, and culture.
Partner with product, design, legal and operations as a peer. Engage thoughtfully in tradeoff conversations about scope, sequencing, and what "done" means in a regulated domain.
Set the technical bar in design reviews and hard tradeoff conversations. Make sure architecture decisions get written down and give the team durable context. Help us build a platform that both engineers and operating teams pine for after they leave.
Grow engineers into architectural thinking by giving them opportunities to step up, and pushing their thinking constructively. 

Who you are

You are a builder. You set new benchmarks for output and want a role where your team ships with autonomy and speed. Not a role where you wait for consensus.
You have 10+ years in engineering and 4+ years managing engineers, including managing managers or senior ICs. 
You move fast by making decisions quickly, not by cutting corners. You know the difference between a reversible call and one that will come back to haunt us. 
You hire well and manage out when you need to. You have built a team you were proud of and you can describe what made it work.
You have shipped AI into production and led a team through the shift. You have views on retrieval, evaluation, latency, and where LLMs break down, and you know when to use AI and when another tool is the right call.
You have been the technical decision-maker, not just the person who runs the process. You can lead a design review and change the answer.
You think in systems. You can hold the team, the platform, the AI layer, and the business constraints in your head at once and see where they don't line up.
You have taste. You can build teams and systems where agents and humans work in harmony without overbuilding.
You have worked in a domain where correctness has consequences: legal, healthcare, financial services, or public safety. You understand why accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable.

Good signals, not requirements

You have worked at both large and small companies and have a preference for small. You understand speed to impact but also know what matters at scale.
Founder or CTO experience.
You have scaled a team through a platform rebuild or replatforming, and can talk about what you got wrong.
Experience with workflow automation.
Prior work with vector search, semantic retrieval, or document understanding systems at production scale.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, QA Engineering
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, QA Engineering based in United States.

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity focused on defining and scaling quality across a complex enterprise software platform. You’ll own the end-to-end QA strategy, establish quality gates, and use meaningful metrics to influence release and roadmap decisions. The role combines strategic leadership with enough technical depth to remain connected to hands-on quality engineering. You’ll lead multiple QA teams and evolve their structure as the organization scales. The position also requires close collaboration across engineering, product, UX, documentation, and field teams to establish shared quality standards. You’ll work in a global, remote environment with a strong focus on reliability, performance, automation, and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities

Own and drive the end-to-end QA strategy, establishing quality gates, standards, processes, and cross-team accountability.
Lead and scale two QA teams spanning functional and reliability engineering, including managers, a principal engineer, and individual contributors.
Evolve the QA organization and operating model to support growth, improve effectiveness, and maximize engineering impact.
Partner with senior and principal engineering leadership to strengthen reliability, performance, resilience, and high-load testing practices.
Guide automation strategy and quality processes that enable engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes efficiently.
Establish comprehensive quality coverage across business users, developers, and administrators/operators in Kubernetes, cloud, and bare-metal environments.
Develop actionable quality metrics, dashboards, and reporting that provide leadership with data-driven insights for roadmap, release, and quality decisions.
Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, documentation, and field teams to embed quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
Stay connected to hands-on QA execution and technical challenges while providing strategic direction and organizational leadership.
Drive continuous improvement and cultural change across QA practices, processes, automation, reliability, and engineering quality.

Requirements

Proven experience leading QA or quality engineering functions within engineering organizations of approximately 100–500 employees, with demonstrable organizational and quality impact.
Strong experience defining and implementing end-to-end QA strategies, quality gates, testing standards, and data-informed quality decision-making across multiple teams.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing managers, senior technical specialists, principal-level engineers, and individual contributors.
Experience scaling QA organizations and developing structures, processes, and operating models that support business and engineering growth.
Strong technical understanding of complex enterprise software products, including functional testing, automation, reliability, performance, resilience, and high-load testing.
Experience covering multiple product personas, including developers, business users, and technical administrators or operators.
Ability to work across Kubernetes, cloud, microservices, and related operational environments.
Strong understanding of automation and CI/CD-integrated testing practices; experience with tools such as Playwright or TestRail is advantageous.
Experience with chaos engineering, advanced reliability testing, or performance benchmarking is a plus.
Ability to influence engineering, product, UX, documentation, and customer-facing teams around shared quality objectives.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and organizational leadership skills.
Comfortable balancing long-term QA strategy with practical involvement in technical execution.
Experience in enterprise software, workflow automation, or similarly complex technical products is highly relevant.
Ability and willingness to use the product as part of the role.

Benefits

Fully remote work with flexible working arrangements.
Home office budget and coworking space support.
Flexible time off.
Competitive, transparent, location-based compensation.
Equity through a Virtual Stock Option Plan where applicable.
Locally tailored healthcare benefits.
Global mental wellbeing support through Modern Health.
Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account supporting health, family, personal interests, experiences, and financial wellbeing, launching in 2026 and scaling to €1,000 annually from 2027.
Retirement and pension plans, often with company contributions.
Life and disability insurance where applicable.
Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-directed professional development, including courses, certifications, and books.
Annual company kickoff events, team offsites, local gatherings, and connection budgets supporting in-person collaboration.
Inclusive, global working environment with opportunities to collaborate across diverse teams and cultures.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: VP Enterprise Business Applications & Technology
jobs.description:
Description

Providence is seeking a transformational technology leader with deep software engineering expertise, large-scale enterprise application experience, and a proven ability to develop AI strategy, lead global teams, and influence stakeholders across a complex healthcare environment.

The Opportunity

The Vice President of Enterprise Business Applications & Technology (EBAT) is responsible for guiding the strategic vision and performance of Providence's enterprise business application and technology portfolio. This executive leads the development and execution of technology strategies that enable operational excellence, business transformation, innovation, and sustainable growth across Finance, Human Resources, Workforce Management, Supply Chain, Real Estate, Legal, Compliance, and other shared services functions.

The Vice President oversees a diverse portfolio that includes custom software engineering, service engineering, data and analytics platforms, automation capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions. In partnership with business and technology leaders, this role establishes priorities, investment strategies, modernization roadmaps, and governance frameworks to ensure technology capabilities align with organizational objectives and deliver measurable business value.

As a senior technology leader, the Vice President is thought leader; accountable for portfolio health, service performance, strategic planning, resource allocation, financial stewardship, talent development, risk management, cybersecurity and regulatory compliance, and the successful delivery of technology initiatives. The role fosters a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while advancing Providence's digital transformation agenda and maximizing the impact of technology investments across EBAT.

Accountabilities Include The Following Operational Categories

Support of functional business partners and executives
Identification and assessment of technical road maps and requirements
Sponsorship of implementation activities
Production support of assigned applications
Support of and maximization of application usefulness
Effective management of vendor relationships.

This position is responsible for leading, mentoring and developing leaders, managers as well as other staff. This position will work in close collaboration with executives, directors, managers and other leaders and staff across the system.

This position will create and successfully execute strategic plans for highly complex issues involving business and information services operations and support. It will also work to standardize complex and disparate processes and methodologies related to application management such as design, deployment, support and life cycle.

Essential Functions

Strategic

Responsible for the development of enterprise business application digital transformation strategy and roadmap.
Develops long term strategy of AI, ML and RPA technologies.
Develops long term strategy of AI, ML and RPA technologies.
Responsible for the pre M&A due diligence and post M&A integration strategy for new affiliations and maintenance of legacy systems.
Responsible for the post M&A technical conversion of new affiliations.
Creates and executes the long term enterprise application integration strategy program for EBAT operations and technology.
Maintains relationships with key business partners and other senior leaders in the IT industry in order to leverage best practices, evaluate and manage emerging application technologies.
Directs adoption process for introducing and implementing new services, technologies and/or applications into Information Services.
Implements appropriate service delivery models for core application functions in defining, delivering, and improving services for the enterprise and its customers.
Responsible for working with leaders of IS Strategy and Business Development in ensuring adherence to standards, and continuously evaluating the effectiveness of application systems.
Ensures that the Applications division supports IS services and systems effectively and meets the needs of the business.
Participates in the development of the overall IS strategic plan by identifying needed application management strategies and projects that support business needs.
Manages customer expectations regarding the success of each Information Services strategy and project; ensures measurable outcomes are defined and reported for each strategy or project.
Partners with key stakeholders and customers to implement application services for strategic initiatives that are effective, user-friendly and accurate.

Management

Manages overall technology program budget and the establishment of project financials and controls.
Develops and negotiates preferred information technology vendor contracts and manages key vendor relationships.
Manages strategic vendor relationships, ensuring financial, compliance, and service level goals are achieved.
Ensures the performance of applications within their domain and evaluates the performance of services on the basis of specific KPIs.
Oversees budgeting and expenditures for applications, staff and services within their span of control.
Assists in the development of and monitors compliance with policies and procedures for Application Services that impact all of Providence St. Joseph Health.
Attracts, hires, trains, motivates, retains, and develops a team of first-rate professionals to perform the responsibilities of applications management.
Designs, implements, maintains, and operates departmental Service Level Agreements, Operating Level Agreements, and associated KPIs.
Demonstrates the ability to build an organization and provide responsive leadership; to delegate, coordinate and motivate staff, and to evaluate performance.
Demonstrates ability to coordinate and facilitate teamwork with multidisciplinary groups, building and reaching consensus; agreeing upon a course of action where there are multiple perspectives.
Demonstrates outstanding organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage shifting priorities.

Operational

Plans for monthly and quarterly releases.
Provides leadership for all support activities.
Develops budgets and expenditures for information services related to applications in partnership with other leaders and the PMO.
Provides executive leadership on critical issues, problems or delays in production, projects or any other issues that have an impact on the customer.
Leads process optimization and initiatives to improve service delivery, increase value and promote customer service.
Maintains the delivery of secure, reliable, and scalable applications and processes that support the growth and financial objectives of Providence St. Joseph Health.
Teams with the business and other IS disciplines to develop and maintain appropriate disaster recovery architecture, projects, and policies and participates in disaster drills for applications.

Qualifications

Education & Credentials

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Business Management, Information Services, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, HR; or equivalent education/experience.
Master's Degree in Information Services, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Administration, or a related IS or healthcare field; or equivalent education/experience (preferred).

Experience & Expertise

Professional & Leadership Capabilities

Ability to analyze information, evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Ability to analyze information gathered by investigation, and report findings and recommendations.

Responsible for working with leaders of IS Strategy and Business Development in ensuring adherence to standards, and continuously evaluating the effectiveness of application systems.
Ensures that the Applications division supports IS services and systems effectively and meets the needs of the business.
Participates in the development of the overall IS strategic plan by identifying needed application management strategies and projects that support business needs.
Manages customer expectations regarding the success of each Information Services strategy and project; ensures measurable outcomes are defined and reported for each strategy or project.
Partners with key stakeholders and customers to implement application services for strategic initiatives that are effective, user-friendly and accurate.

Management

Manages overall technology program budget and the establishment of project financials and controls.
Develops and negotiates preferred information technology vendor contracts and manages key vendor relationships.
Manages strategic vendor relationships, ensuring financial, compliance, and service level goals are achieved.
Ensures the performance of applications within their domain and evaluates the performance of services on the basis of specific KPIs.
Oversees budgeting and expenditures for applications, staff and services within their span of control.
Assists in the development of and monitors compliance with policies and procedures for Application Services that impact all of Providence St. Joseph Health.
Attracts, hires, trains, motivates, retains, and develops a team of first-rate professionals to perform the responsibilities of applications management.
Designs, implements, maintains, and operates departmental Service Level Agreements, Operating Level Agreements, and associated KPIs.
Demonstrates the ability to build an organization and provide responsive leadership; to delegate, coordinate and motivate staff, and to evaluate performance.
Demonstrates ability to coordinate and facilitate teamwork with multidisciplinary groups, building and reaching consensus; agreeing upon a course of action where there are multiple perspectives.
Demonstrates outstanding organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage shifting priorities.

Operational

Plans for monthly and quarterly releases.
Provides leadership for all support activities.
Develops budgets and expenditures for information services related to applications in partnership with other leaders and the PMO.
Provides executive leadership on critical issues, problems or delays in production, projects or any other issues that have an impact on the customer.
Leads process optimization and initiatives to improve service delivery, increase value and promote customer service.
Maintains the delivery of secure, reliable, and scalable applications and processes that support the growth and financial objectives of Providence St. Joseph Health.
Teams with the business and other IS disciplines to develop and maintain appropriate disaster recovery architecture, projects, and policies and participates in disaster drills for applications.

Exposure to cloud solutions demonstrated understanding of ERP cloud applications.
Healthcare knowledge and experience preferred.
Experience issuing or responding to RFIs and RFPs.

jobs.title: Division Head - Technology Strategy & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Div Head - Technology Strategy & Governance
Company:
PT Integra Putra Mandiri
Location:
Jakarta, Indonesia
Employment Type:
Contract
Industry:
IT Services and IT Consulting

About the Role

Provide technical authority for technology strategy, enterprise and solution architecture, technology standards, and cross-domain governance, ensuring that IPM's technology landscape remains aligned, scalable, secure, and fit for business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy:
Translate business and transformation priorities into technology strategy, principles, roadmaps, and investment priorities.
Enterprise & Solution Architecture:
Lead enterprise and solution architecture, technical design, architecture reviews, and key technology decisions across company domains.
Technology Standards & Governance:
Establish architecture principles, technology standards, reference architectures, policies, and governance mechanisms.
Cross-Domain Architecture:
Ensure alignment across enterprise applications, AI solutions, digital platforms, and IT operations, including integration and shared technology capabilities.
Technology Risk & Technical Assurance:
Identify architectural and technology risks, challenge proposed solutions where required, and ensure appropriate technical assurance before major technology decisions.
Innovation & Technology Planning:
Assess emerging technologies, conduct technology evaluations, and recommend practical opportunities for innovation and platform improvement.
People & Capability Development:
Develop architecture capability, establish knowledge management, mentor technical leaders, and strengthen the organization's technical decision-making discipline.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 12 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, technology strategy, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years in a senior architecture or technology leadership position
Industry background: System Integrator, Technology Services, Digital, Enterprise IT, or related industries
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field

Skills

Enterprise architecture (EA), solution architecture, technology architecture, and technical design
Architecture standards, principles, reference architectures, technology roadmaps, and technology governance
Application, integration, data, cloud, infrastructure, and security architecture across complex environments
Architecture review, technical decision-making, technology standards, and design authority
Technology strategy, portfolio assessment, platform rationalization, and technology investment planning
Integration architecture and cross-domain technology alignment across enterprise applications, AI solutions, digital platforms, and IT operations
Technology risk, security architecture awareness, policy, control, and governance
Senior stakeholder management, technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional influence

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Job function

Information Technology

Industries
